system.description:
Your mastery of the mind has grown so complete that a spoken word alone bends others to your will, with no meeting of eyes required.

You may now use all other Dominate powers without eye contact. To activate this power you need only be able to see and speak to the target — and you must actually speak to the target and have the target understand you; being merely within earshot does not suffice. Once thus engaged, the underlying Dominate power resolves as normal, requiring its usual Mental Challenge.
